items.title: Scaling Jira to ~6M Versions
items.summary: Jira Search has to keep up as our customers’ data grows. Our largest customers tracks millions of releases, and for us that meant supporting nearly 6 million software release versions. At that scale, even preparing a search query became a bottleneck.
